desc: The Gujarat Hybrid Renewable Energy Park or Khavda Solar Park is a renewable energy park under construction near Vighakot village in Kutch district of Gujarat, India. Slated to be the world's largest hybrid renewable energy park, it is being built on 72,600 hectares of waste land. It is expected to generate 30 gigawatts from solar panels and wind turbines, enough to power 18 million Indian homes.
fact: As of April 2026, its capacity has increased to 9.4 GW · 1 GW capacity was commissioned in March 2024
